description: Defines classes, structs, and interfaces for unit conversion management, including units, categories, conversion data, and callback interfaces. Implements the UnitConverter class with methods for initialization, category and unit management, and currency data handling.

classes.name: Unit
classes.description: Represents a measurement unit with properties like id, name, abbreviation, and conversion roles.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a category of units, with id, name, and support for negative values.

classes.name: UnitHash
classes.description: Hash functor for Unit objects based on id.

classes.name: SuggestedValueIntermediate
classes.description: Intermediate structure for suggested conversion values.

classes.name: ConversionData
classes.description: Holds ratio, offset, and offset order for unit conversions.

classes.name: CurrencyStaticData
classes.description: Contains static information about a currency and its country.

classes.name: CurrencyRatio
classes.description: Represents a currency conversion ratio between two currency codes.

classes.name: IViewModelCurrencyCallback
classes.description: Interface for currency data load callbacks.

classes.name: IConverterDataLoader
classes.description: Interface for loading unit conversion data.

classes.name: ICurrencyConverterDataLoader
classes.description: Interface for loading currency conversion data.

classes.name: IUnitConverterVMCallback
classes.description: Interface for unit converter view model callbacks.

classes.name: UnitConverter
classes.description: Implementation of IUnitConverter managing categories, units, and currency data.

methods.name: StringToVector
methods.description: Converts a delimited string into a vector of strings.

methods.name: CheckLoad
methods.description: Checks if data is loaded successfully.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Performs unit conversion based on conversion data.

methods.name: UpdateViewModel
methods.description: Updates the view model with current data.

methods.name: AnyUnitIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if any unit is empty.

methods.name: GetDataLoaderForCategory
methods.description: Retrieves data loader for a specific category.
